search_strategy: Breadth-first, source-by-source. Cloned the repo and read the pre-existing online_status_tracker.py/base_online_request_processor.py fully first (steps 1-45). Then dumped the ENTIRE BookStack wiki (179 pages) including comments to local text files (transcript line 2711-2861) and grepped/skimmed them -- correctly concluded (line 5148) that the wiki was unrelated to this ticket's hidden design, matching the plant record's fact that all 46 g10 remarks live in chat and none in wiki or mail. Fetched Gitea issue 207 and its comments (only tangentially relevant), then dumped all Gitea issues/PRs with comments locally (line 5149). Read mail over IMAP but found nothing g10-relevant. The decisive step was bulk-dumping ALL 12 Mattermost channels to /tmp/chat/<channel>.txt at once (line 3485-3499: pipeline 2036 msgs, releases 694, viewer 319, etc), then running one composite keyword grep (capacity/refund/settle/debt/reserv/booking-family terms) across all 12 files, which returned per-file hit counts (code-review 13, cookbooks 4, engineering 21, general 4, help 0, incidents 8, pipeline 24, releases 9, viewer 7; off-topic/random/town-square 0). It then iteratively widened context around each hit -- reading whole 20-60 line windows of pipeline.txt, code-review.txt, engineering.txt, incidents.txt, cookbooks.txt, general.txt, releases.txt and viewer.txt -- and cross-referenced herrings against their later reversals every time ('that was the review call last year... and its gone'). Coverage was uneven: channels with more initial keyword hits (pipeline, engineering, code-review, incidents) got dense, repeated re-reads and yielded nearly all their remarks; channels with fewer hits (cookbooks, general, releases, viewer) got only one or two narrow windows each, and help.txt (0 hits, 1 remark) was never opened manually at all. No truncation or crashed helper scripts; the terminal-screen rendering only shows the tail of each command's output, which cost some re-reads but not correctness. The final design (line 6211) was assembled as a single coherent synthesis before any code was written.

The agent correctly triaged all three non-chat surfaces (wiki, Gitea issues/PRs, mail) as unproductive for this specific ticket before committing to a chat-only strategy -- expensive (dumped 179 wiki pages, ran a background Gitea issue/PR scraper) but methodologically sound, and it matches the actual plant (100% chat, per hidden_requirements.md's 'Where the remarks are spread' table).
